_childDocuments_.review: Horribly unrealistic. Nonsensical boxing game. Have been waiting forever for this but it honestly is not good at all. The multiplayer is ridiculously laggy. No other game has lag like this. The best way to win is to throw the same punch repeatedly. The ai on the highest difficulty isn't challenging, you just have to cheese them by throwing the same hook to the body or head and let them gas themselves out. The fact that the damage is targeted to specific parts of the body makes the game awful on top of the horrid glitches and lag. There's issues where your punches become so slow it's insane, just not realistic in the slightest when you are low on stamina. meanwhile the AI will spam combos the whole match. Multiplayer is damn near unplayable so I can barely even comment on it. I can't recommend this at all and I'm terribly disappointed. I understand it's early access but it's not looking promising. Updates aren't coming out fast enough. considering the stage the game is in, they're rare. They should've spent less time scanning fighters faces and put effort into the game itself. The fact it's been pushed back so much and this is the product they've released is embarrassing, regardless of it being early access. I'm honestly pissed. How did they not realize the issue with the targeted damage system? Just take two steps back and spam hooks. That's the whole game. The only time I've seen an actual knockout and not a TKO is from the AI randomly putting me on my ass after winning every round of the fight because of the targeted damage. On lower difficulties you take unbelievable amounts of damage and far too much focus is put on counters when dodging just doesn't work. Your punches often won't land when they should be. The distance you throw your punch randomly changes and can't keep up with the pace of the game. If you play this casually you might enjoy it. Good luck getting a game online that isn't totally ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ laggy. And have fun never knocking an opponent out even when you have Wilder spamming his right. Needs serious work before it can be taken seriously at all. The things they advertised aren't there. The most damage you'll see on fighters are bruises and black eyes on their face. Not even redness on the body. Everytime you get a tko(every ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ fight) the same terrible animation occurs where the player flops over like a fish with their eyes wide open. Why are they suddenly unconscious from a TKO? This needs an insane amount of changes to be made before it can be played competitively. In fact, you barely can play online at all. Seriously disappointing. There's also hackers already. There's so much that needs fixed, this honestly shouldn't even be on steam.Edit: Glitches have gotten worse since they've released a couple updates. Often times my fighter will be frozen whenever I am rocked. Can't move, can only throw punches and block, even in single player. some how there is even serious input delay in single player. Online is still a laggy, glitchy mess with people using the same 3 overpowered boxers so it's not enjoyable at all. Stop adding boxers and fix the game.

_childDocuments_.review: Feels a little disingenuous to give a negative review with so many hours in the game played, so will put a disclaimer those hours came from the 2 years of Early Access the game was previously in.Going into the full release of Undisputed, I was under the impression that the bugs and balance issues of the Early Access were to be fixed, and this would then be the final product.  Instead what was offered was a game with lower graphics, less balance, more exploits, higher desyncs issues, constant crashes and freezes, and to top it all off some issues from the Early Access, never even got fixed and were ported over to the now full release, showing a complete lack of feedback being acknowledged or heard.I won’t go into great detail about balance issues, I’m sure other reviews mention power punch spam, the hook meta, the push exploit, etc. For me the biggest disservice is greatly lowering the skill gap, boxing is a difficult sport, it should be a difficult game, but for whatever unknown reason with the console release they’ve also dumbed down the game immensely, a simplified game although makes it easier for new players to pick up and play/learn, will fail to keep a dedicated playerbase around long term, the game seems to have taken a giant leap away from the concept of simulation boxing, and towards a more cartoony and arcade experience, yet is still sold as an authentic boxing experience.As the player I want to be in full control, yet now the game has added so many “lottery effects” that melts the game down to the random number generator holding influence between wins and losses. Between RNG staggers, frozen lean back state, input drops, random misses/clipping through bodies, mini stuns, flash knockdowns, flash knockouts, increased doctor interactions, these are effects we the player don’t control, if I hit you with 5 power punches, maybe I get a stagger on all 5, maybe I get it on none for example, when 1 stagger can give a free knockdown, this background calculator is now dictating so much of how the match plays out, without full control coming from the player, often matches now look like player 1 will spam “X” to try and lottery “Y” effect.Random will only favour the worse player in its core concept, as the better player will win via skill difference, but if you throw in random elements, now the weaker of the 2 players has a chance where there was none before, this results in nothing more than a nerf to the better player, and lowers the skill gap between good and bad.In the end if you want to buy the game, go for it, but be realistic, if you want to buy it for an authentic boxing experience as it was sold, then I’d suggest you save your money, this isn’t it, but if you want the game for more of an arcade unrealistic experience, then you might enjoy it.

_childDocuments_.review: Sadly I got lured into buying the game, since AFAIK it's the only multiplayer combat sport title right now on PC right now. If you want to box properly, this is not the game for you, unless you're godlike, but then you will still lose about half your matches to spammers. Power-hook spamming is really the only good option as of now, and knowing the history of the game, it won't really change anytime soon. Also, punches are randomly not hitting on target, head movement doesn't work and regular punches deal zero damage. Don't be a fool like me, do NOT buy this game.
